title: 360° Vehicle Safety System
tagline: No blind spot goes unwatched, even offline.

meta.title: 360° Vehicle Safety System | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: No blind spot goes unwatched, even offline.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Forklifts and loaders move in tight spaces with real blind spots, and the driver often can't see a person standing right behind the vehicle.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Four wide-angle cameras feed an edge AI device running YOLOv8 detection; a dashboard shows all feeds live while a speaker escalates its alert as objects get closer.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Blind-spot accidents designed out, on a system that keeps working with zero internet dependency.
